name: leadrescue
description: LeadRescue: staff-reviewed AI inquiry triage for a moving company (CloudQuest Business Solutions Lab).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && python3 -m pip install -r backend/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && python3 backend/local_server.py
scripts.reset:demo: python3 -c "import os; p='backend/data/local/leadrescue-db.json'; os.path.exists(p) and os.remove(p); print('Demo data cleared. It is reseeded on next start.')"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run lint:infra
